projects.title: VEATION
projects.desc: Fulldome, 360 rooms and flat screens on one timeline, edited in the final format and in real time. VEATION is the editor the studio built for its own immersive work, now in private beta with studios, artists and venues in eight countries.
credits: Created by: Alma Digital Studio
body: VEATION is immersive video editing software by Alma Digital Studio. Fulldome, 360 rooms and flat screens share one timeline, and the work is edited in its final format, in real time.

Every dome show we made started the same way: cut it flat, render it, walk into the dome and find out. So we built the editor we wanted. The dome view plays while you edit, with 26 GPU effects, audio-reactive visuals, looping motion without keyframes and an export that comes out exactly as you saw it.

Rito Digital, the studio's fulldome concert, was made in VEATION and performed live in the CULTVR dome in Cardiff. VEATION itself was presented and demonstrated in that dome at FulldomeUK 2026, and is now in private beta with studios, artists and venues in eight countries.

projects.desc: An immersive live concert film by Alma Digital Studio: realistic stop-motion animation and ceremonial techno across eight songs, always performed live. It premiered at FOC — The Festival of Consciousness, Barcelona, in 2026.
presentedAt: The Festival of Consciousness (FOC), CCIB Barcelona, July 2026 — premiere, closing show

credits: A work by Alma Digital Studio

body: Rito Digital is an immersive live concert film created by Alma Digital Studio: a prologue and eight songs, 60 minutes, always performed live. The film adapts to three projection setups: fulldome, 360° room and single projection.

Donzio crosses two worlds, from the System to the Rite, meeting the families of beings that inhabit them. It is animated in realistic stop-motion: tactile silicone creature-puppets in a weathered retrofuturist world, with diorama depth, ritual symmetry and 35mm grain, composed with generative imagery directed frame by frame. The original score, performed live, is ritual techno with hypnotic electronics and a latin house pulse, experimental vocal processing and live handpan.
The eight steps: Creation, Almagical, Vaina Wena, Care for Her, Guirotron, Free Spinning, Dancing with Myself and Creativity. Each step is a song and a world.

It premiered at the closing show of FOC — The Festival of Consciousness, in Barcelona in July 2026, before 1,000 people. The fulldome version premiered at CULTVR Lab in Cardiff in September 2026 and returned to the same dome in October.
Eight songs and a procession.

projects.title: Neural Canvas
projects.desc: An interactive VR painting experience where each participant paints freely for two minutes while an EEG sensor tracks their state of calm, folding brain activity into the creative gesture itself. The 200 individual sessions were assembled into a single collective artwork, unveiled live at the EUIPO headquarters in Alicante.
presentedAt: EUIPO, Alicante, Spain — EIT Culture & Creativity Innovation Forum
credits: Created and Produced by: Alma Digital Studio
Visuals & Music by: Vicente Manzano & Beltrán Lihn
Development by: Beltrán Lihn & Nicolas Pirelli
body: Neural Canvas VR is an interactive VR painting experience created by Alma Digital Studio for the EIT Culture & Creativity Innovation Forum.
Each participant steps into a virtual studio and paints freely for two minutes while an EEG sensor tracks their state of calm, folding brain activity into the creative gesture itself.

The 200 individual sessions are assembled into a single collective artwork, unveiled live at the EUIPO headquarters in Alicante. The piece distills the studio's thesis: creativity, biofeedback and wellbeing in one measurable, shared experience.

projects.title: Collective Pulse
projects.desc: Visitors place a finger on a pulse sensor and their heartbeat appears on a large-scale projection as a living organic form, beating at their own rhythm. When several people are read at once, their forms share the same field, drifting toward one another or pulling apart. Nothing is pre-rendered: each form lives only for its session.
presentedAt: ArtLac Gallery, IDB Bank, Washington DC, USA
credits: Created and Produced by: Alma Digital Studio
Visuals & Music by: Vicente Manzano & Beltrán Lihn
body: Real-time biometric installation for groups. Visitors place a finger on a pulse sensor and their heartbeat appears on a large-scale projection as a living organic form, beating at their own rhythm.

When several people are read at the same time, their forms share the same field: they drift toward one another or pull apart. The piece runs on a custom real-time engine developed in-house, rendering at 60fps. Nothing is pre-rendered — every form exists only during the session that produced it, and disappears with it.

The work makes no claim that an audience synchronises. What the room shows is behaviour, attraction and dispersion, and what it asks is older than the sensor: what, if anything, a group of bodies shares when they are read together.

projects.title: Digital Sanctuaries
projects.desc: Immersive wellbeing rooms in VR for hotels, offices and institutions. Guided breathing, rest and focus sessions, from 3 to 15 minutes, in a room that responds to the physiological state of whoever is inside.
credits: Created by: Alma Digital Studio
Imagery: visualisations by Alma Digital Studio
body: Digital Sanctuaries designs and installs VR wellbeing rooms for hotels, offices and institutions. Guided breathing, rest and focus sessions, from 3 to 15 minutes, in a room that responds to the physiological state of whoever is inside. A spin-off of Alma Digital Studio.

The room is installed once and the experiences are licensed, with new content every season. Each session is short by design: it fits between two meetings or around a check-in, and lets one room welcome many people in a day.
The content is made by an immersive art studio: light, sound and rhythm composed as a single perceptual input. The catalogue descends from the studio's own work, beginning with Soul Charger.
Fifteen minutes in which nothing asks anything of you.
